name: persistent Stage-2 Level-4 validation-only core selector

selection.pareto: remove candidates weakly dominated on all three Medium coordinates
selection.maximin: maximize min(metric / best eligible metric) on the Pareto front

low_policy.reason: a mandatory prediction-only Low guard is trained after the core checkpoint is frozen; it cannot alter High or Medium
low_policy.final_composite_requirement: on 350-399, Low guard must have nonnegative Mean/P1/P10 gain over its core and final Low must pass paired no-significant-decline versus native Hattrick

checkpoint_requirement: immutable archived checkpoint matching train history and per-epoch validation files
test_data_policy: neither training wrapper nor watcher opens snapshots 400-499
